hooks.command:
if command -v rebar >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && rebar check --cold-start; elif [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/rebar" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && ./bin/rebar check --cold-start; else printf '<rebar-cold-start>
rebar not found in PATH — build it (cd cli && go build -o ../bin/rebar .) or install rebar
</rebar-cold-start>
'; fi
